projectDescription: The tooling that enables ESLint to support TypeScript, providing a parser, plugin with 100+ rules, and shared configurations for type-aware linting.
keyFeatures: TypeScript-aware ESLint parser (@typescript-eslint/parser) supporting full TypeScript AST
100+ ESLint rules tailored for TypeScript, including type-aware rules using TypeScript's type checker
Shared configurations (recommended, strict, stylistic) for drop-in linting setup
Typed linting support that leverages TypeScript's type information for deeper code analysis
Utilities for building custom ESLint rules with TypeScript support (@typescript-eslint/utils)
Rule tester with full TypeScript support (@typescript-eslint/rule-tester)
publicApiSurface: tseslint.config() — helper to define flat ESLint configs with type safety
tseslint.configs.recommended — recommended ruleset without type information
tseslint.configs.recommendedTypeChecked — recommended ruleset requiring type information
tseslint.configs.strictTypeChecked — strict ruleset with type information
tseslint.configs.stylisticTypeChecked — stylistic rules with type information
tseslint.parser — ESLint parser for TypeScript files
@typescript-eslint/utils ESLintUtils.RuleCreator — factory for custom typed rules
@typescript-eslint/rule-tester RuleTester — test utility for ESLint rules
@typescript-eslint/typescript-estree parse() — parse TypeScript into ESTree AST
@typescript-eslint/scope-manager analyze() — scope analysis for TypeScript AST
